title: Drone Strikes Hit Military Sites in El Obeid and Nyala
detail: Drone strikes on September 28, 2026 hit the Olympic Stadium, used as military barracks, in El Obeid, triggering an explosion at an arms depot inside and partly damaging the nearby Sheikan Medical College, with civilian injuries reported. A separate strike in Nyala, South Darfur, hit an RSF headquarters compound where two missiles were fired and one struck a guest house; RSF casualties were reported but unverified.
